text:
anya (PM): quick check — with the infra pool delay (ETA ~2w) can we reconfirm what absolutely needs to be in MVP vs what gets pushed to v1? timeline's slipping and i want a clear cutlist.

mike (Eng): we won't have dedicated infra for the first shard window. engineering suggests trimming background reindex, tenant migration, and admin bulk-ops from MVP. keep core inference paths.

dina (ML Eng): model pinning + quantization smoke is failing on some 8-bit builds. shipping 8-bit in MVP feels risky unless we treat it as opt-in behind a flag. need a small eval harness.

tom (Design): from UX: drop multi-tenant onboarding and advanced admin flows from MVP. keep single-tenant happy path and graceful error states.

olivia (Solutions): customer pilot (Acme) prioritizes SSO + embeddings. they're flexible on tenant migration as long as SSO is in MVP.

anya (PM): proposal: MVP = core chat + SSO + embeddings (read + small write for pilot) + embeddings cache enabled by default; defer tenant migration, admin UI, analytics, large reindex jobs to v1. flag the 8-bit runtime as opt-in. thoughts?

mike (Eng): +1 on deferring heavy migrations. we need the embeddings cache kept (feature-flag toggle) otherwise latency blows up. will add risk notes.

dina (ML Eng): i'll own the regression eval set and alerts. feature-flag is fine, but add automatic rollback if CER exceeds threshold.

tom (Design): :thumbsup: i'll remove multi-tenant flows from the MVP prototype and update screenshots.

olivia (Solutions): i'll tell Acme: SSO in MVP, tenant migration in v1. they should accept that.

anya (PM): locking scope for now — i'll turn this into a short cutlist doc. MVP committed items: core chat, SSO, embeddings (read + pilot write), embeddings cache (flagged), basic telemetry. Deferred to v1: tenant migration, admin bulk UI, analytics retention, large reindex. @mike please ack and post a PR with cutlist + known risks by EOD.

mike (Eng): ack. i'll open the PR with the cutlist and a dev plan for feature flags + fallback by 18:00.

deploy-bot: milestone update: "MVP-scope-lock" moved to 2025-05-12 on the deploy board.

anya (PM): thanks all — we'll review the PR tomorrow at the sync and finalize timeline reset if needed.
